title: The Negative answer from the office
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：negative　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 negative 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the nurse wrote of ① a negative answer from the office in the report, and everybody in the ward said at once that it was ② so negative that nobody in the ward would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the nurse, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the negative ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the negative answer from the office that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report for April 1957 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too negative to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sufferer who had come to help; the negative ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a negative attitude of the pupils, and said that no sufferer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as negative as the attitude of the pupils they had once had in the old ward. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was negative or not, and he said so.

By 1970 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was ⑦ something negative, and nothing besides. The sufferer from the next ward called the whole plan ⑧ quite negative; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the report kept the names of the negative ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1973, with great care, she wrote of another negative answer from the office in the same report, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less negative than anybody had expected. ⑩ The negative attitude of the pupils that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1975, was the one she could never quite name; the negative ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 消极（前置定语 a negative answer from the office：1963 年护士在护理记录里记下的那件消极的答复）
B. adj. 消极／否定（两处加强说法：so negative that … 与 no less negative than …）
C. adj. 消极／否定（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 消极（表语 too negative to do：母亲觉得它太消极，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 否定（前置定语 a negative attitude of the pupils：叔叔把整件事称作一桩否定的态度）
F. adj. 否定（同级比较 as negative as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩学生消极的态度相比）
G. adj. 否定（后置定语 something negative：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 否定（受程度副词修饰 quite negative：那位病患的评价）

items.q: a negative answer from the office
the negative answer from the office that
a negative attitude of the pupils
The negative attitude of the pupils that

answers.why: negative 意为“消极”，1963 年护士在护理记录里记下的是“一件消极的答复”，此处作前置定语 a negative answer from the office。
negative 意为“消极”，此处用 so negative that 结构，说它消极到病房里没人敢靠近。
negative 意为“消极”，护理记录上 四月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的消极办公室否定的答复，等于最高级的说法。
negative 意为“消极”，母亲认为这件东西“太消极了，谁也用不上”，too negative to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
negative 意为“否定”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩否定的态度”，此处作前置定语 a negative attitude of the pupils。
negative 意为“否定”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩学生消极的态度一样否定”，同级比较用 as negative as。
negative 意为“否定”，护理记录上那半行字要的是“否定的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something negative。
negative 意为“否定”，邻病房来的那位病患认为这套计划“相当否定”，quite 修饰原级 negative。
negative 意为“否定”，no less negative than 表示“其否定不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之否定不亚于任何人的预料。
negative 意为“否定”，母亲 1975 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的否定态度”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，护士在护理记录里记下了一件消极的答复。（a negative answer from the office）
它消极到病房里没有一个人敢靠近。（so negative that …）
母亲觉得它太消极，谁也用不上。（too negative to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩否定的态度。（a negative attitude of the pupils）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩学生消极的态度一样否定。（as negative as …）
到了 1970 年，护理记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件否定的东西。（something negative）
answers: In 1963 the nurse wrote of a negative answer from the office in the report.
It was so negative that nobody in the ward would go near it.
My mother thought it too negative to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a negative attitude of the pupils.
He said nobody would call it as negative as the attitude of the pupils they had once had.
By 1970 the report asked for nothing but something negative.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 negative 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the nurse wrote of a negative answer from the office in the report, and nobody forgot it.
It was the negative answer from the office that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report says.
My mother thought it too negative to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a negative attitude of the pupils, and nobody argued with him.
The sufferer from the next ward called the plan quite negative, and everybody laughed.
The negative ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
